digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, completion verifier, close precheck
propositions: [operator-attested] tag on code-verifiable acceptance criteria with repository path/symbol evidence bypassed plan-review guards and reached the completion verifier
evidence-kind criterion ran but produced no finding despite AC text citing exact test file paths, leaving only nondeterministic LLM judgment as a blocking layer
det_measurement_provenance detected missing provenance: lines but was wired as ADVISORY (p6_ac_quality contract), allowing tagged ACs to pass review
A deterministic close-path guard (txn.ensure_attested_items_valid) is required to reject laundered attestations before the completion verifier, since the verifier must trust the tag per ADR-0043

Mixed-evidence false positives (orientation citations vs. proof citations) required per-line evidence judgment with marker words to distinguish legitimate provenance statements from repository context
Post-certification retagging escapes attestation invalidation and must stale the signed plan-review attestation to prevent the laundering vector from repeating
